component.name: fieldseal-suite
component.description: FieldSeal Suite — local forensic capture, joint/independent countersign, and unified verification toolkit. Open source under the MIT License; the MIT License does not restrict or condition any right it grants. Commercial support/integration/assurance are optional services, not dependencies. ZERO third-party runtime dependencies: the trusted kernel uses only Node.js built-in modules and Web-native APIs (Web Crypto, Web Streams). No npm runtime package, no CDN, no third-party WebAssembly, no vendored crypto/zip/pdf library. Browser checks use headless Chrome as dev/test tooling only (not shipped).

components.name: Node.js built-in modules
components.description: node:crypto, node:fs, node:path, node:stream, node:zlib, node:url, node:child_process, etc. Built into the Node.js runtime; not a third-party package.

components.name: Web Crypto / Web Streams APIs
components.description: Browser-native crypto.subtle and Web Streams used by pwa/core/. Not a third-party package.

properties.name: fieldseal:scope
properties.value: browser platform API (not shipped, not vendored)

components.name: pwa/vendor (first-party adapters)
components.description: First-party adapter/glue code written by the project (RFC3161 TSA adapter, extension-hook slot). SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. NOT third-party code and NOT redistributed upstream code.

components.name: Headless Chrome
components.description: Used by cli/test/ui-browser-check.mjs and ui-e2e.mjs for browser-subset verification. Not shipped in the runtime product.

components.name: python3 http.server
components.description: Optional local static file server for the PWA. Standard-library runtime tool, not a dependency and not shipped.
